spec.hypothesis: Depth signal is NOT a domain artifact from Wikipedia seed text. Three tests: (A) d1-d3 only 3-class RF should be >>33% chance, (B) seed-stratified LOGO should show stable accuracy across article groups, (C) features should predict depth but NOT seed group (negative control).
spec.data_count: 9 cells x 20000 samples each (d1-d3 only: 15000 per cell)
spec.reviewer_issue: R1-W2 + R3-W1: Wikipedia domain bias inflates d0 recall
sub_experiments: C: depth vs seed_group prediction (negative control)
